title: Move the Shield and Rescue round-2 panels’ inline words into lib/words
body:
## Summary
modules/shield/Panels.tsx and modules/rescue/Panels.tsx render about 24 user-facing string literals inline instead of from lib/words/shield.ts and lib/words/rescue.ts.

## Description
docs/ux/UX-GUIDE.md:208-209 checklist: "Strings live in lib/words.ts or the area’s lib/words/<area>.ts, and the area’s words guard passes". apps/desktop/client/src/windows/main/modules/shield/Panels.tsx:20-34 (WeekTiles: "Checked this week", "none looked safe", "Paused for you", "nothing blocked"...), :54-63 (ComparePanel: "What’s normal vs this payment", "What’s normal", "This payment"), :94-97 (CheckLights "The shield’s checks" twice); apps/desktop/client/src/windows/main/modules/rescue/Panels.tsx:13-22 FixGet/FixGetOff ("What the subscriber would get" twice, "They’d get", "Nothing: not offered for this renewal"). None is covered by the area words guards (wordsOf(SHIELD) / wordsOf(RESCUE)). Fixed: SHIELD.panels.* / RESCUE.get.* entries, the panels read them, the guards cover them.

## Flow
- grep JSX string literals in the two Panels files: ~24
- move each into the area words file (shared surface: commit immediately)
- extend the shield/rescue words guards to the new keys

## Expected impact
Copy review and the words guard see every Shield/Rescue panel string; nothing user-visible changes. Could break: a typo in a moved string (the scale smoke tests render both panels).

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - every area string under the words guard
Before: ~24 inline literals in 2 files, 0 guarded
After: predicted 0 inline, all guarded
Method: simulation - counted by reading; not built here because it touches two shared words files beyond an S
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: grep count of JSX string literals in both Panels files (24 -> 0) plus the area words-guard tests extended to the new SHIELD/RESCUE keys

title: Keep invoice-kind deals out of Rescue’s recovered list, as Rust does
body:
## Summary
The client files DealKind invoice under Rescue (logic.ts moduleOf, rescue/model.ts isRescueDeal) while Rust files it under Book and counts only kind=rescue as recovered, so a paid invoice reads "Paid, but not shown paid by PayPal with a saved receipt".

## Description
crates/table-attention/src/lib.rs:159 routes DealKind::Invoice to Module::Book; crates/table-ledger/src/rescue.rs:100 COUNTED requires d.kind='rescue'; table-runtime rescue_book lists only DealKind::Rescue cases (crates/table-runtime/src/rescue.rs:106-114). The client: apps/desktop/client/src/windows/main/logic.ts:43 (invoice -> rescue) and apps/desktop/client/src/windows/main/modules/rescue/model.ts:120 isRescueDeal (rescue || invoice). recovered() (model.ts:148-163) then gives a settled invoice deal the reason 'unverified' (RESCUE.notCounted.unverified), a false statement about PayPal. Fixed: isRescueDeal = kind rescue only, and moduleOf agrees with Module::Book (or the reason says "not a rescue").

## Flow
- an invoice-kind deal settles (RECEIPTED, receipt verified)
- Rescue > Recovered money lists it: "Paid, but not shown paid by PayPal with a saved receipt"
- Rust never counts it because it is not a rescue

## Expected impact
The recovered list states only true reasons. Could break: Book/Rescue module counts for invoice deals (none in the mock worlds today).

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - recovered reasons match Rust
Before: 1 of 1 constructed invoice deal (RECEIPTED) reads 'unverified'
After: predicted 0 of 1 (absent from the Rescue list, or reason 'not a rescue')
Method: simulation - walked recovered() by hand; out-of-scope seam (logic.ts moduleOf belongs to another context)
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
crates/table-attention/src/lib.rs:159  table_core::DealKind::Invoice => Module::Book
crates/table-ledger/src/rescue.rs:100  COUNTED: d.kind='rescue' AND ...
apps/desktop/client/src/windows/main/logic.ts:43  case 'invoice': return 'rescue';
apps/desktop/client/src/windows/main/modules/rescue/model.ts:120  isRescueDeal: rescue || invoice
instrument: model.test.ts: recovered() over a RECEIPTED kind=invoice deal (reason before: unverified) plus a moduleOf parity test against table-attention lib.rs Module routing

title: One fewRows helper for the console lists instead of three copies
body:
## Summary
FEW_ROWS/fewRows is defined identically in three area parts files.

## Description
apps/desktop/client/src/windows/main/console/areas/book/parts.tsx:234-235, apps/desktop/client/src/windows/main/console/areas/rescue/parts.tsx:299-300 and apps/desktop/client/src/windows/main/console/areas/shield/parts.tsx:191-192 each export FEW_ROWS = 6 and fewRows(n). It sets ListEngine's .few class, so it belongs beside ListEngine. Fixed: one export from console/ListEngine.tsx, three imports.

## Flow
- grep "export const fewRows": 3
- move to ListEngine, re-point imports
- 3 -> 1

## Expected impact
A change to the short-list threshold lands once. Could break: nothing visible (same value).

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - one definition
Before: 3 copies
After: 1
Method: probe - grep count over src; book/parts.tsx is another context, so out of this round's paths
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: grep -c "export const fewRows" over src (3 -> 1); typecheck; book/rescue/shield layer tests

title: Make End in a renewal’s fixes land on the last open fix
body:
## Summary
In the Rescue fixes radio group, End and the digits 2-4 target fixes that are not offered, so the key does nothing.

## Description
apps/desktop/client/src/windows/main/console/areas/rescue/parts.tsx:147-156 (Picks.onKey): moveCell returns DOWNGRADE for End and COLS[n] for a digit (modules/rescue/model.ts:186-189); the off() guard then drops the move. Three of four levers are NOT_BUILT (model.ts:76-80), so End and 2-4 are dead keys on every renewal; the arrows already skip the off ones. Fixed: End walks back from the last column to the last open fix (Home already lands on Do nothing).

## Flow
- open a failed renewal's fixes, focus "Do nothing"
- press End: focus stays (expected: the discount, the last open fix)
- press 4: nothing

## Expected impact
Keyboard users reach the last open fix in one key. Could break: the 0-4 digit shortcut meaning (column number).

## Evaluation
Claim: user - End reaches the last open fix
Before: End on 1 of 1 walked renewal: no move
After: predicted focus on the discount
Method: simulation - traced onKey with COLS and NOT_BUILT; a DOM keyboard test is the instrument
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: rescue.test.tsx: fire End on the focused "Do nothing" radio in the large world, assert document.activeElement is the discount radio (red before)

title: Route the fix panel’s amount through atRiskOf
body:
## Summary
rescue/parts.tsx Picks and FixPanel compute view?.offer.cycle ?? dealTotal(deal) inline instead of calling atRiskOf.

## Description
apps/desktop/client/src/windows/main/console/areas/rescue/parts.tsx:157,231 repeat atRiskOf's expression (apps/desktop/client/src/windows/main/modules/rescue/model.ts:172). Rejected: identical values on both sides; pure churn.

## Flow
- compared the two expressions: identical by construction

## Expected impact
None.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - one definition
Before: 2 inline copies, amounts identical to atRiskOf
After: 0 copies, amounts identical
Method: probe - read both expressions
Result: not-better
Gate: none
